crossRefs.note: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being…
For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant…
This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe…
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…

translations.web: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
translations.bsb: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
translations.kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
translations.asv: So shalt thou find favor and good understanding In the sight of God and man.
